questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
A stitch in time saves nine.
options: 1) It is better to solve a problem straight away and not let it become bigger.
2) Time spent on useless activities must be avoided.
3) It is good to stitch together small bits.
4) It is better to take timely action and you will become prosperous.
questions.solution: A) A stitch in time saves nine(idiom) – It is better to solve a problem straight away and not let it become bigger. समय पर किया गया कार्य बड़ा नुकसान होने से बचाता है
